tool_schemas.name: run_sql_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL statement against the specified logical database and returns the query results (up to result_limit rows) along with an auditable execution record including any server-reported error details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id does not match the required format, sql_text is empty/invalid, result_limit is outside 1–10000, or unexpected fields are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND if the database_id does not exist or is not accessible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to query the target database; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller exceeds configured execution/logging limits, and CONFLICT when the statement cannot be executed due to transactional/locking conflicts or incompatible database state.

database_id.description: Target logical database to execute the SQL against.

sql_text.description: SQL statement to execute (typically a SELECT or other read/query statement).

parameters_json.description: Named parameters for the SQL statement, if supported by the server.

client_metadata_json.description: Arbitrary client metadata to attach to the request for auditing.

result_limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the result set before truncating.

tool_schemas.name: create_table
tool_schemas.description: Creates and tracks a new table definition in the specified logical database and executes a CREATE TABLE operation (using sql_text when provided, otherwise using table_schema_json as the tracked schema description), returning the created table metadata and an auditable execution record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id/table_name are invalid, table_schema_json is missing or malformed, sql_text (when provided) is not a CREATE TABLE statement, or unexpected fields are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND if the database_id does not exist or is not accessible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks DDL privileges on the database; raises CONFLICT if a table with the same name already exists or the create operation is rejected by the server due to schema/state conflicts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when creation or auditing limits are exceeded.

database_id.description: Database in which to create the table.

table_name.description: Name of the table to create.

engine.description: MySQL storage engine to use for the table (e.g., InnoDB).

table_schema_json.description: JSON description of the table schema (e.g., columns, primary key, indexes) to persist for tracking.

sql_text.description: Optional explicit CREATE TABLE SQL to execute (if provided, it is what will be executed/audited).

client_metadata_json.description: Arbitrary client metadata to attach to the request for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: insert_data
tool_schemas.description: Inserts one or more row objects into the specified tracked table within the given database and returns an execution summary including affected row count and an auditable execution record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id/table_id do not match required formats, rows_json is empty or not an array of objects, row fields are invalid for the tracked schema, or unexpected fields are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND if the database, table_id, or the table’s mapping within the database cannot be found or accessed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks INSERT permission; raises CONFLICT when inserts violate constraints (e.g., duplicate keys/foreign keys) or are rejected due to transactional/locking conflicts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write or log volume limits are exceeded.

rows_json.description: Array of row objects to insert, keyed by column name.

client_metadata_json.description: Arbitrary client metadata to attach to the request for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: update_data
tool_schemas.description: Updates rows in the specified tracked table that match where_sql, setting the column/value pairs in set_json, and returns an execution summary including affected row count (respecting limit when provided) plus an auditable execution record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id/table_id formats are invalid, set_json is empty or contains unknown/invalid columns, where_sql is empty/invalid, limit is provided but < 1, where_parameters_json does not satisfy referenced parameters, or unexpected fields are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND if the database or table_id does not exist in the specified database or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks UPDATE permission; raises CONFLICT for constraint violations or transactional/locking conflicts that prevent the update, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when update or auditing limits are exceeded.

set_json.description: Column/value pairs to set for matching rows.

where_sql.description: SQL WHERE clause (without the 'WHERE' keyword) to select rows to update.

where_parameters_json.description: Named parameters referenced by where_sql, if supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to update.

client_metadata_json.description: Arbitrary client metadata to attach to the request for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: delete_data
tool_schemas.description: Deletes rows from the specified tracked table that match where_sql and returns an execution summary including affected row count (respecting limit when provided) plus an auditable execution record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id/table_id formats are invalid, where_sql is empty/invalid, limit is provided but < 1, where_parameters_json does not satisfy referenced parameters, or unexpected fields are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND if the database or table_id does not exist in the specified database or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks DELETE permission; raises CONFLICT for transactional/locking conflicts or constraint/state conditions that prevent deletion, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when deletion or auditing limits are exceeded.

where_sql.description: SQL WHERE clause (without the 'WHERE' keyword) to select rows to delete.

where_parameters_json.description: Named parameters referenced by where_sql, if supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to delete.

client_metadata_json.description: Arbitrary client metadata to attach to the request for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: list_mysql_databases
tool_schemas.description: Lists logical MySQL databases visible to the authenticated caller, with optional filtering by status and name. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses requests with invalid pagination parameters or unexpected fields, and rejects unauthorized/invalid API keys.

database_name_prefix.description: Filter to databases whose database_name starts with this prefix (case sensitivity is server-defined).

limit.description: Maximum number of databases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_mysql_database
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single logical MySQL database by id. Returns the database metadata if found. Refuses invalid ids, and returns NOT_FOUND if no such database exists or it is not visible to the caller.

database_id.description: ID of the logical database to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: list_mysql_tables
tool_schemas.description: Lists tracked tables within a logical database, with optional filtering by status and table name. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses invalid database_id, invalid pagination parameters, or unexpected fields.

database_id.description: Database whose tracked tables will be listed.

table_name_prefix.description: Filter to tables whose table_name starts with this prefix.

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_mysql_table
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tracked table by id. Returns the table metadata including tracked schema. Refuses invalid ids, and returns NOT_FOUND if no such table exists or it is not visible to the caller.

table_id.description: ID of the tracked table to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: list_sql_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists auditable SQL execution requests created by the authenticated caller, optionally filtered by database/table, tool name, operation type, status, and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses invalid filters, invalid pagination parameters, or unexpected fields.

database_id.description: Filter requests executed against the given database.

table_id.description: Filter requests associated with the given tracked table.

tool_name.description: Filter by the tool that created the request record.

created_after.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity resolved from the presented API key, including API key id, name, current status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption where available. Refuses missing/invalid credentials and rejects revoked API keys.

include_usage.description: When true, include best-effort current per-minute and daily usage counters and reset times (if tracked by the server).

metadata.name: MySQL Database Access Server
metadata.description: This backend models a MySQL Database Access Server that executes SQL statements on behalf of authenticated clients and keeps an auditable history of what was executed, against which schema objects, and with what outcome. Core workflows are: define/track logical databases and tables, execute DDL/DML
